description: Search a specific instance (by id or exact name) for files whose name matches a glob, plus files whose text contains the glob's literal part (so "**/*motd*" also finds files containing "motd"). Each hit's `matched_by` says whether its name, its content, or both matched. Names match case-insensitively, and binary files such as .jar only match by name. Leading folder names scope the search: "mods/*mek*" only looks inside /mods. Use this instead of walking the tree with list_files when you know roughly what a file is called or what is written in it. To search inside one known file, use read_file with `contains`.

glob.description: Glob pattern relative to the instance root, e.g. "**/*.properties" or "mods/*mekanism*". A plain string with no glob characters is matched as "**/*<value>*" inside its folder. The response echoes the folder and glob actually searched.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.
